meta.title: Justo — Your receipts and expenses, made simple
meta.description: Justo is the mobile app that helps you track your personal and professional receipts. Simple, clear, just.

hero.title: Your receipts and expenses, finally under control.
hero.subtitle: Justo stores your personal and professional receipts in one clear, elegant app. Keep every proof of purchase at your fingertips. Itemized expenses or the standard deduction? Justo lets you track your spending and make an informed choice.

about.title: Everything that matters, in one place
about.lead: Justo digitizes your receipts and invoices.

features.title: Digitized receipts
features.body: Scan or import your receipts. They are sorted, searchable and always available.

features.title: Budget analysis
features.body: Justo analyzes your receipts and detects what is most advantageous for you on your tax return.

features.title: Our ambition
features.body: Freeing up your time and energy by supporting you in managing your expenses.

features.title: Protected data
features.body: Your receipts are encrypted and you remain the sole owner of your data.

how.title: Three steps, no more
how.lead: Getting started with Justo takes less than a minute.

steps.title: Download the app
steps.body: Install Justo from the App Store or Google Play and create your account in seconds.

steps.title: Add your receipts and documents
steps.body: Snap a receipt or import an invoice. Justo will organize them by category.

steps.title: Expense reports
steps.body: See directly in the app whether you are better off itemizing your actual expenses or taking the 10% standard deduction, and extract the deductible amount of your expenses year after year.

team.title: A small team, a high bar
team.lead: Justo is designed in France by a team passionate about simplicity and useful things, with one obsession: saving you time and peace of mind.

values.title: Simplicity
values.body: We strip away everything non-essential and keep only what's useful.

values.title: Trust
values.body: Your data is yours. Transparency and security come first.

values.title: Closeness
values.body: We listen to our users and improve Justo every week.

download.title: Available on iOS and Android
download.lead: Download Justo for free and take back control of your receipts today.

support.title: Have a question? We're here
support.lead: Our support team replies quickly and with a smile.

partner.title: Let's build Justo together
partner.lead: Are you a merchant, creator or investor? Join the Justo journey as a partner or founding member.

footer.tagline: Your expenses and receipts, at your fingertips.
